def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Solid uniform lines partition the grid into rectangular regions.
    row_seps = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    col_seps = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    rs = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    cs = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    separator_colors = {grid[i][0] for i in row_seps} | {grid[0][j] for j in col_seps}
    from collections import Counter
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in separator_colors)
    background = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    result = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rs, rs[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cs, cs[1:]):
            anomaly_count = sum(
                grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] not in separator_colors
                for r in range(r0 + 1, r1) for c in range(c0 + 1, c1)
            )
            row.append(1 if anomaly_count >= 2 else background)
        result.append(row)
    return result
PY
